items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: George Young, this one guy I played with a lot

ctx.x: How do you get up for a studio date over the years. Is playing in the studio sort of a different mindset than being in a live situation?

Oh my God, yeah. I’m still trying to get used to being in the studio you know. I’ve had experiences playing with real studio guys, this one saxophone player – well a lot of them but I mean George Young, this one guy I played with a lot, that was what he did, he excelled at it. So when he – he did so many sessions. He would take another take on something and he would always improve. I mean he just knew how – he was so defined you know. It’s like playing under a microscope you know. So your every note, your every…
Somebody yelling something from the audience.
